Define phi = Abelian.epiDesc q w hwzero, so comp_epiDesc gives q followed by phi equal to w. Replace the quotient tuple b by the images of the supplied lift tuple c, use the formula for q, and evaluate the factorization on the tensor of wedges. title: Gluing a chosen family of local wedge morphisms
statement: A chosen family of local wedge morphisms satisfying the prescribed formula glues to a global morphism satisfying that formula.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_glue_family {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁]
    (φU : ∀ U : X.Opens, exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂)
    (hformula : ∀ (U : X.Opens)
      (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
      (φU U).val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := r₃) (U := U) b)) =
        wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₂) (U := U)
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))) :
    ∃ φ : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
        φ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
            (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := r₃) (U := U) b)) =
          wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₂) (U := U)
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
